fix_decisions.claim_text: New sentence says a query reaching a renamed or dropped table is refused before it runs; guard only checks the loaded tables mapping, so the old name reaches the database and fails with its own error
fix_decisions.evidence: RuleSetGuardRunner.run_sql always calls the inner runner with require_base_tables=True (src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py:894-896); the MySQL runner then runs verify_base_tables on the rewritten SQL before executing it (src/sqllens/agent/integrations/mysql/sql_runner.py:156-157); a table absent from information_schema.TABLES gets kind None and raises RlsError 'could not verify a base table; query blocked' (src/sqllens/safety/relations.py:186-190), which RefusalRedactingRunner redacts. The old name is therefore refused before execution.
